pending_legislation.status: pending committee action as of 2026-11-11, not enacted
pending_legislation.proposal: 10% per-year cap on combined banked and capital-improvement increases through 2029-12-31; retroactive to notices served on or after 2026-09-15 if enacted as drafted

scenarios.exposure: banked portion above the proposed 10% ceiling if File No. 261020 is enacted as drafted

banking_unit_b.maturation_rule: banks 12 full months after first imposable; additive only (Rules 4.12, 4.10)

flags.item: Building coverage, 1940 construction year and rent-control status
flags.detail: Owner intake only; never authenticated against parcel or Rent Board records. All unit analysis assumes coverage.

flags.item: Rent-increase license and Housing Inventory status for both units
flags.detail: No portal access; cannot confirm whether reports were filed or a license is active. Every scenario is conditional on this.

flags.item: Lawful base rent for Unit A ($3,995.00 claimed) and Unit B ($3,150.00 claimed)
flags.detail: Intake amounts are not rent ledgers; concessions, passthroughs or prior overcharges would change every computed figure.

flags.item: Unit A actual occupancy (one original and one subsequent occupant reported)
flags.detail: Roommate composition reported but not documented here; affects the Costa-Hawkins/6.14 analysis only, not the allowance arithmetic.

flags.item: Unit B intervening increases since 2019-06-01
flags.detail: Any increase or concession since 2019 shrinks the 11.5% assumed bank; if unknown, treat B-3 as an upper bound, not an entitlement.

flags.item: Whether the reported 2026-04-01 Unit A arrangement created a fixed-term lease, and whether timely Rule 6.14 written notice was given
flags.detail: A fixed term can bar mid-lease increases; a missed reasonable-time notice can convert a subsequent occupant’s status.

flags.item: Lease terms, addenda, subsidy or program restrictions for both units
flags.detail: No lease document was reviewed; subsidies can layer program rules on top of the ordinance.

flags.item: Allowable increase for effective dates on or after 2027-03-01
flags.detail: Not yet published; expected around March 2027. The Form 571 table carries a deliberately blank row.

flags.item: Final text and enactment of Board of Supervisors File No. 261020
flags.detail: Pending Land Use and Transportation Committee as of 2026-11-11 (Legistar record 8217304). If enacted as drafted, combined banked and capital-improvement increases cap at 10% per year for notices on or after 2026-09-15. Recheck before serving any banked increase.

flags.item: Neighborhood market-norm increase for Outer Sunset / 94122
flags.detail: No official benchmark exists; the verified lawful allowance is the 1.6% citywide annual figure. Any 'normal for the neighborhood' number here would be fabrication.

flags.item: How large corporate owners in practice choose increases vs individual owners
flags.detail: No official empirical study reviewed; only the legal common denominator could be verified.

flags.item: City rent-increase page worked-example date label
flags.detail: The first example on the live page ties the 1.6% rate to a June 1, 2025 effective date even though 1.4% governed that period; the labeled period is the typo, the 1.6% heading period (2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28) is correct. Verified persisting on 2026-11-11.

flags.item: City banked-increases page example label
flags.detail: An example on the banking page mislabels an August 1, 2024 date with the 1.4% figure that belongs to the 2025-26 period; surrounding rule text and Form 571 are consistent.

flags.item: internal/notes.md ordinance number 261015
flags.detail: Should read File No. 261020 per the official legislative record (pending committee action, introduced 2026-09-15). Audited, not edited - owned by another session.

flags.item: Repository citation hygiene
flags.detail: Form 1007 URL with literal [74] instead of %5B74%5D (verified-register row R60 and scripts/build.py), leginfo citations with trailing periods, and HTML entities inside a CSV column.

flags.item: Frozen 2026-11-07 research date on the archived base page set
flags.detail: Predates the 2026-11-09 File No. 261020 posting; hub pages are newer. Refresh belongs to the owning sessions.

flags.item: Historical personal identifiers in public git history
flags.detail: Prior commits contain literal identifier tokens (F15-class finding by earlier sessions). Current files scan clean; erasure needs a history rewrite by the repository owner and is not performed here.

flags.item: Banking-forfeiture interpretation for an early Unit A increase
flags.detail: The statement that imposing an annual increase before 2027-02-01 ends accrual of the skipped 1.4% is this session’s reading of Rule 4.12(a)’s 12-month maturation, applied consistently with the City’s published examples; the Rent Board has not ruled on this property. Treat as interpretation, not adjudication.

flags.item: Exemption eligibility for the Rent Board Fee
flags.detail: No owner facts (owner-occupancy, program participation) were verified; deadline and amounts are verified, eligibility is not.

flags.item: Email or text message service sufficiency
flags.detail: Civil Code Sec. 827 authorizes personal delivery or statutory mail; no official authorization of electronic service for these notices was identified. Treated as unavailable; confirm with counsel before relying on electronic service.

identical legal duties; empirical practice comparison unverified (FR-11)
written 30/90-day notice with dollar, percentage, effective date; no reason required by rule
twelve-point stress test; free tenant petition route with no deadline
